self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R5 Infusion Arrow at max stacks: Normal/Charged Attack hits grant a stacking buff (up to 4 stacks, each lasting 6s) of +8% ATK per stack, for +32% ATK at max stacks. The accompanying +2.4% Normal Attack SPD per stack is not modeled (non-combat stat).

en.flavor: An exotic metallic bow from a distant land. Though extremely difficult to maintain, it is easy to nock and fires with tremendous force.

refinements.1: Normal Attack and Charged Attack hits increase ATK by <r>4%</r> and Normal ATK SPD by <r>1.2%</r> for 6s. Max 4 stacks. Can only occur once every 0.3s.
refinements.2: Normal Attack and Charged Attack hits increase ATK by <r>5%</r> and Normal ATK SPD by <r>1.5%</r> for 6s. Max 4 stacks. Can only occur once every 0.3s.
refinements.3: Normal Attack and Charged Attack hits increase ATK by <r>6%</r> and Normal ATK SPD by <r>1.8%</r> for 6s. Max 4 stacks. Can only occur once every 0.3s.
refinements.4: Normal Attack and Charged Attack hits increase ATK by <r>7%</r> and Normal ATK SPD by <r>2.1%</r> for 6s. Max 4 stacks. Can only occur once every 0.3s.
refinements.5: Normal Attack and Charged Attack hits increase ATK by <r>8%</r> and Normal ATK SPD by <r>2.4%</r> for 6s. Max 4 stacks. Can only occur once every 0.3s.

fr.flavor: Un arc en alliage de métal, dont la corde est tendue par des poulies. Son étrange design le rend difficile à manier, mais une fois la flèche est partie, celle-ci s'abat sur la proie avec une force impressionnante.
